thesis: WMG is a high-beta, highly levered name (beta 1.32, debt about 4.9B vs cash 0.59B) being bought into a 0.95-confidence risk-off regime with VIX at the 99th percentile and QQQ below both its 50- and 200-day averages. The stock has bounced to a 4.2% extension over SMA20 with RSI 66, and the pre-market quote of 33.26 is above the technician's entry zone, so any fill at the last price is a chase. Reward/risk is only 1.61 from mid-zone and falls to about 1.0 at the top of the zone, with nearer resistance at the 20-day high of 33.49. The earnings print was a possible EPS miss with conflicting sources, and part of the margin gain may be one-time cost cuts, so the post-earnings reversal could be a relief bounce that fails if the market keeps falling.
